Use-case & requirements summary (short):
- Primary product: in-IDE completions + line/whole-function generation, real-time signature/help. Heavy emphasis on streaming partial tokens (low-latency first-byte).
- TTFT target: median <=50ms, 95th <=120ms (customer target).
- Throughput: concurrent active devs 400-800 per region; bursty (morning/standups).
- Token budget model: per-session soft budget (e.g., 2k tokens/session) + per-request max tokens. Need tooling to tune to keep interactive feel w/o runaway costs.
- Jitter/backpressure: must handle server-side batching/backpressure without degrading cursor experience. Need graceful partials, client-side smoothing, fallback to smaller quantized model when queue >threshold.
- Model/versioning: want strict pinning per release channel (stable/canary/dev). Auto-fallback policy when pinned version unavailable.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs for prompts, optional data residency in NA, KMS for key management.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- TTFT median <=50ms for 80% of interactions across dev workstation profile set.
- 95th pct <=120ms or degraded UX mitigated via smooth partials.
- Token budget controls in Console + runtime hooks to throttle/give warnings to client.
- Demonstrate model pinning + canary rollback w/o IDE client update.
